Name: (CP) Linus Lives in a Cabin Dialogue
Author: Quody
Description:
This is a companion mod intended to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12536?tab=description]Linus's Cabin[/url] by Unapol. Big shoutout to them for recreating that excellent mod.

So you wanted Linus to have himself a humble cabin to keep warm in the winter. Yet every now and then, someone mentions a non-existent tent.
I decided to find every entry of text calling it his tent and instead make it appropriately cabin themed. I've not had time to play test every instance, but I believe I studied the coding well enough that it'll work. Just let me know if you see someone talking about a tent and I'll see about fixing it.

I've covered these dialogue instances;
Conversation with Townsfolk
Giving Linus a gift he hates
Festival of the Ice

This mod also has compatibility built in to detect if certain mods are installed and patch their dialogue as well. It only works as long as this mod is loaded after any other mod, hence why I've named the folder "(CP) z_Linus Lives in a Cabin Dialogue". As long as you don't rename the mod folder it should work.

These are the following supported mods;
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion by Ben and ParadigmNomad[/url] - More Linus Dialogue
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded by FlashShifter[/url] - Victor Dialogue
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village by Rafseazz and mamaesh[/url] - Bert and Undreya Dialogue


If you like this mod, you may consider my completely unrelated (AT) Spooncrows series.


Thanks for listening to my short ramble.

-Spooner
